display.purpose: Home, draft, and result route headings; scale and weight carry emphasis.

headline.purpose: Draft and result route identity; large enough to orient the next decision.

body.purpose: Instructions, state explanations, and practical interface copy.

description.purpose: Ability summaries, component details, and recovery explanations.

label.purpose: Short slot, state, and action labels that need a compact uppercase rhythm.

meta.purpose: Patch, round, slot, state, and other secondary metadata.

cardTitle.purpose: Champion and component names; names wrap instead of disappearing.

mono.purpose: Rounds, slots, routes, serials, and other data-like measurements only.

shadows.name: panel
shadows.purpose: Quiet ambient separation for working surfaces.

shadows.name: board
shadows.purpose: Places the angled champion board in the home scene.

shadows.name: primary-action
shadows.purpose: Separates the next action from the page ground.

motion.name: fast
motion.purpose: Button, slot, navigation, and disclosure state changes.

motion.name: standard
motion.purpose: Longer interface transitions where a little settling improves orientation.

motion.name: home-splash
motion.purpose: The home board artwork entering the first viewport.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The next draft action, rendered as a compact gold board control.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 2.8rem; padding: .75rem 1rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: .25rem; color: #07111c; background: #e7c982; box-shadow: 0 .8rem 1.6rem rgba(0,0,0,.3); font: 700 .72rem/1 'Avenir Next', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .075em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: transform 140ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), background 140ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #f0d99a; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0ac8b9; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A lower-emphasis route or recovery action with a structural border.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 2.8rem; padding: .75rem 1rem; border: 1px solid rgba(240,230,210,.32); border-radius: .25rem; color: #f0e6d2; background: transparent; font: 700 .72rem/1 'Avenir Next', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .075em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: border-color 140ms ease, background 140ms ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color: #0ac8b9; background: rgba(10,200,185,.08); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #e7c982; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Champion Board
components.description: The angled home object that pairs a labelled fixture with the six-slot build strip.
components.css: .ds-champion-board { position: relative; overflow: hidden; padding: 1rem; border: 1px solid #c8aa6e; background: #0d1825; box-shadow: 0 1.8rem 2.5rem rgba(0,0,0,.4); transform: rotate(-3deg); } .ds-champion-board__art { min-height: 20rem; border: 1px solid rgba(240,230,210,.15); background: #1b3a52; } .ds-champion-board__slots { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr); border-top: 1px solid rgba(240,230,210,.15); }

components.name: Site Navigation
components.description: Home, Solo draft, and Rooms routes, with persistent room return and leave status beneath the header.

components.css: .ds-site-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .25rem; } .ds-site-nav a { padding: .72rem .85rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: .25rem; color: #c1bdaf; font: 700 .67rem/1 'Avenir Next', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-site-nav a:hover, .ds-site-nav a[aria-current='page'] { border-color: rgba(240,230,210,.32); color: #e7c982; background: rgba(200,170,110,.05); box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 #e7c982; } .ds-site-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #e7c982; outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-site-nav { display: none; } }

components.name: Component Choice Card
components.description: A source-tied choice with visible metrics, availability state, and a full-details disclosure.
components.css: .ds-component-card { display: flex; min-width: 0; flex-direction: column; border: 1px solid rgba(200,170,110,.42); border-radius: 0; color: #f0e6d2; background: #0d1825; } .ds-component-card--selected { border-color: #e7c982; background: rgba(200,170,110,.1); } .ds-component-card__select { display: flex; width: 100%; flex: 1; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: .75rem; padding: .9rem; border: 0; color: inherit; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; font: inherit; text-align: left; } .ds-component-card__select:hover { background: rgba(200,170,110,.1); } .ds-component-card__topline { display: flex; width: 100%; justify-content: space-between; color: #7f91a4; font: 700 .6875rem/1 'SFMono-Regular', monospace; letter-spacing: .05em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-component-card__topline span { color: #e7c982; } .ds-component-card__select strong { font: 700 1.125rem/1.05 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .02em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-component-card__select p { margin: 0; color: #c1bdaf; font: .875rem/1.5 'Avenir Next', sans-serif; } .ds-component-card__details-toggle { min-height: 2.75rem; padding: .7rem .85rem; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(240,230,210,.15); color: #0ac8b9; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; font: 700 .6875rem/1 'SFMono-Regular', monospace; letter-spacing: .07em; text-align: left; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-component-card__details-toggle:hover, .ds-component-card__details-toggle:focus-visible { color: #e7c982; background: rgba(200,170,110,.08); } .ds-component-card__select:focus-visible, .ds-component-card__details-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0ac8b9; outline-offset: -3px; }

components.css: .ds-details-dialog { width: min(calc(100vw - 2rem),46rem); max-width: calc(100vw - 2rem); max-height: calc(100vh - 2rem); padding: 0; border: 1px solid rgba(200,170,110,.42); border-top-color: #0ac8b9; color: #f0e6d2; background: #13283b; box-shadow: 0 1.5rem 3rem rgba(0,0,0,.28); overflow: hidden; } .ds-details-dialog::backdrop { background: rgba(3,8,15,.78); } .ds-details-dialog__surface { max-height: calc(100vh - 2rem); overflow-y: auto; padding: clamp(1rem,3vw,1.5rem); } .ds-details-dialog header { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; padding-bottom: .8rem; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(240,230,210,.15); } .ds-details-dialog header span { color: #7f91a4; font: 700 .6875rem/1.3 'SFMono-Regular', monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-details-dialog h2 { margin: .45rem 0 0; color: #f0e6d2; font: 700 clamp(1.5rem,4vw,2.5rem)/1 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-details-dialog__close { min-height: 2.8rem; padding: .75rem 1rem; border: 1px solid rgba(240,230,210,.32); border-radius: .25rem; color: #f0e6d2; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; font: 800 .7rem/1 'Avenir Next', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .075em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-details-dialog__close:hover, .ds-details-dialog__close:focus-visible { border-color: #0ac8b9; color: #e7c982; } .ds-details-dialog p { max-width: 70ch; margin: .85rem 0 0; color: #c1bdaf; font: .875rem/1.5 'Avenir Next', sans-serif; }

components.css: .ds-shared-stage { display: grid; gap: 2rem; color: #f0e6d2; } .ds-shared-stage__header { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: clamp(1.5rem,4vw,4rem); padding-bottom: 1.5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(240,230,210,.15); } .ds-shared-stage__status, .ds-shared-stage__join > span, .ds-shared-stage__phase > span { color: #0ac8b9; font: 800 .65rem/1.3 'Avenir Next',sans-serif; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-shared-stage h2 { margin: .6rem 0 0; font: 700 clamp(2.4rem,6vw,5rem)/.98 'Helvetica Neue',sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-shared-stage__header p, .ds-shared-stage__phase p { color: #c1bdaf; font: 1rem/1.5 'Avenir Next',sans-serif; } .ds-shared-stage__join { display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: .35rem; min-width: 12rem; padding: .85rem; border: 1px solid rgba(200,170,110,.42); border-radius: .35rem; background: #0d1825; } .ds-shared-stage__join strong { color: #e7c982; font: 700 1.8rem/1.1 'SFMono-Regular',monospace; letter-spacing: .13em; } .ds-shared-stage__qr { display: grid; width: 8rem; aspect-ratio: 1; place-items: center; color: #07111c; background: #f0e6d2; font: 700 .75rem/1 'SFMono-Regular',monospace; } .ds-shared-stage__phase { display: grid; gap: .35rem; padding: clamp(1rem,2.4vw,1.8rem); border: 1px solid rgba(240,230,210,.15); border-radius: .35rem; background: linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(19,40,59,.94),rgba(13,24,37,.94)); box-shadow: 0 1.5rem 3rem rgba(0,0,0,.28); } .ds-shared-stage__phase h3 { margin: 0; font: 700 clamp(1.5rem,3vw,2.2rem)/1.08 'Helvetica Neue',sans-serif; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-shared-stage__header { grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr); align-items: start; gap: 1.25rem; } .ds-shared-stage__join { justify-self: start; } }

narrative.overview:
BuildChamp is a compact drafting game for League of Legends players who want to make a quick, subjective build choice. The interface keeps the Split Champion Board: a clear action and short rule beside a champion board. The board is an authored interface object, not a paper ticket, stats dashboard, or imitation of the League client.

The atmosphere is low-light and focused. Deep blue surfaces establish the play space, warm gold marks a decision, and teal marks active or confirmed state. The same vocabulary carries into private-room entry, participant phases, and reveals. Shared display screens prioritize the room code and QR beside a read-only view of public progress and completed builds. Headings use a stable grotesk face; copy describes the action plainly.
keyCharacteristics: A split first viewport with a large direct headline and an angled champion board.
League-inspired navy, parchment, gold, and teal palette without Riot or League branding.
Helvetica Neue display headings with Avenir Next body copy and sparse measurement mono.
Six-slot strips and cards that keep Body, Q, W, E, R, and Passive visible in order.
Home, Solo, Rooms, participant, and read-only shared-display screens share the same board language.

rules.name: The Decision Color Rule
rules.body: Gold identifies a choice or action; teal identifies state. Neither color is allowed to carry meaning without a visible word or shape.

rules.name: The Plain Voice Rule
rules.body: Use a direct verb for an action and a factual sentence for a state; avoid trailer copy, hype, and invented claims.

rules.name: The Placed Object Rule
rules.body: Use a shadow to place the board or action in the scene, never to make every panel look like a floating card.

dos: Do make the six-slot mechanism visible before secondary explanation.
Do use Helvetica Neue or a similarly sturdy neutral grotesk for display headings.
Do keep gold for decisions and teal for status, with text labels for both.
Do label the fixture and keep the solo route untimed and account-free.
Do use direct, factual UI copy that tells the player what to do next.
Do keep the active-room return and Leave banner visible across app routes.
donts: Don't use ticket, perforation, stamp, or faux-paper motifs.
Don't use Riot or League logos, artwork, or implied endorsement as BuildChamp identity.
Don't use an Impact-style or novelty-condensed display stack.
Don't turn the interface into a stats dashboard or add an automated strength score.
Don't make marketing language, color, motion, or sound the only explanation of a state.
